For instance, a 16-year-old working under a retail or hospitality award might be entitled to around half the adult rate for their classification level, while a 17-year-old could receive closer to three-quarters.

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the minimum wage for a 16-year-old in 2026?
A 16-year-old in 2026 would fall under junior employee rates. These are typically calculated as a percentage of the adult minimum wage and vary by age.
